title: Glessner's Prairie front windows and grilles set on their stone courses
items: The four first-floor windows on Prairie Avenue now sit lower, as HABS sheet 6 and the 1965 photograph show them. Each sill rests on the eighth granite bed, 8.71 ft over the door sill instead of 9.2, and each head is 14.3 ft, so the windows keep the drawing's 5.6 ft height. The basement grilles' heads drop to the fourth bed, 4.54 ft from 4.7. The door, the porte-cochère, the small pair and the second floor were checked and left as built.
